revision_summary: Three targeted fixes needed: (1) Timestamp correction — the landline quote 'No? No. Because I'm talking on a landline...' is attributed to 07:52 but actually begins around 07:58-08:03 in the transcript; correct the ts in state_changes[2] and the bill/usage multi_touch_pattern entry. (2) Schema reference correction — script_coverage's 'tax_credit_qualifier' entry is mislabeled; the quoted content ('Is your credit score above 670?') maps to qualifiers.credit_qualifier, not the tax-credit disclosure. Note in revision that the actual tax_credit_disclosure was never given on this call, which is a separate, unflagged gap. Also correct the schema_reference on the 11:42 objection_inversion_miss entry to coaching_philosophy.bill_anchoring, since the utility billing-dispute vent isn't a customer objection to Ion's offer (objection_inversion's defined triggers are cost/time/interest pushback, not third-party utility frustration). (3) Add missed scope-creep moments: the customer's two direct financial questions at 14:46 ('how much do I have to put down') and 15:57 ('does that pay back or no') were answered by the rep with specific guarantee language ('we guarantee savings') — this is closer-tier content the setter should have deferred, and per analysis_directives.scope_creep_detection this should be explicitly counted and flagged as a cherry_pick_moment, not just parked in the handoff_brief's promises list. Additionally, soften the superlative language in coaching_focus[0] ('single richest and most consequential moment... clearest schema-defined miss') to a calibrated priority-1 framing without absolute claims.
